options_evaluated: Post-consumer recycled Polypropylene (rPP) with 30% glass fiber reinforcement
Bio-based Polylactic Acid (PLA) composite with flax fibers
decisions.trade_off: Balancing mechanical durability and impact resistance (to prevent premature physical failure) against the carbon footprint and circularity of the raw material.
decisions.recommendation: Post-consumer recycled Polypropylene (rPP) with 30% glass fiber reinforcement
decisions.rationale: It significantly lowers the embodied carbon footprint compared to virgin engineering plastics while the glass fiber reinforcement provides the necessary impact strength and drop-resistance required for hand tools, ensuring a long product life.
decisions.design_action: Verify the supply chain consistency, contaminant levels, and mechanical property tolerances of post-consumer recycled PP resins from potential compounding partners.

options_evaluated: Threaded fasteners (steel screws) mating into molded-in plastic bosses
Co-molded snap-fits with integrated release points
decisions.trade_off: Ultrasonic welding minimizes part count and assembly time but prevents non-destructive disassembly, whereas threaded fasteners allow repair but increase material diversity and assembly complexity.
decisions.recommendation: Threaded fasteners (steel screws) mating into molded-in plastic bosses
decisions.rationale: Prioritizes end-of-life disassembly and repairability. Using standard steel screws allows users to open the device with common household tools to replace worn parts, and the steel can be easily separated magnetically during recycling.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the feasibility of using a single, standardized screw drive type and size (e.g., Torx T10) across all external housing joints to simplify the disassembly tool requirements.

decisions.trade_off: Brushed motors have lower embodied environmental impacts in their control electronics but suffer from shorter lifespans and lower efficiency, whereas BLDC motors are highly efficient and durable but require complex, resource-intensive electronic controllers.
decisions.rationale: The BLDC motor eliminates brush wear, drastically extending the operational lifespan of the tool. The higher energy efficiency also reduces battery degradation rates and operational energy consumption, offsetting the initial impact of the control electronics.
decisions.design_action: Check the market availability of modular BLDC motor assemblies that integrate the driver circuitry onto a easily detachable PCB to facilitate separate electronic recycling.

options_evaluated: Convective heat routing to an internal structural aluminum gearbox
decisions.trade_off: Open housing vents are simple and lightweight but allow dust and moisture ingress (reducing product lifespan), whereas fully sealed conduction-based cooling protects components but adds weight and material complexity.
decisions.recommendation: Convective heat routing to an internal structural aluminum gearbox
decisions.rationale: By using the structural metal gearbox as a heat sink, the design can remain sealed against dust and debris (increasing reliability in dirty environments) without requiring an active fan or adding non-functional thermal mass.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the thermal conductivity specifications of candidate non-toxic thermal interface materials (TIMs) to ensure efficient heat transfer from the motor to the gearbox housing.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge-based design (separate battery, motor/gearbox, and switch modules)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
decisions.trade_off: High modularity increases the initial plastic volume, connector count, and weight (higher transport impact) but drastically simplifies repair and component harvesting; monolithic designs are lightweight but unrepairable.
decisions.recommendation: Modular cartridge-based design (separate battery, motor/gearbox, and switch modules)
decisions.rationale: It allows the user to easily swap out high-wear components (like the battery pack or trigger switch) without soldering. This extends the overall product life and facilitates clean material separation and component harvesting at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Verify the spatial constraints and assembly clearance within the handle housing to accommodate standardized plug-in connectors instead of soldered joints.

options_evaluated: Removable/standardized cylindrical Lithium-Ion pack (18650 cells) with USB-C charging
decisions.trade_off: Integrated cells allow for a smaller, lighter tool but render the entire product e-waste once the cell degrades; removable packs add weight and volume but preserve the tool's utility indefinitely.
decisions.recommendation: Removable/standardized cylindrical Lithium-Ion pack (18650 cells) with USB-C charging
decisions.rationale: The battery is the most common failure point. Making it removable ensures the tool outlives the chemical lifespan of the cells. Integrating USB-C charging directly on the battery pack eliminates the need to ship a proprietary wall charger, reducing systemic e-waste.
decisions.design_action: Investigate existing open-standard battery interfaces or compatibility with existing tool battery ecosystems to avoid designing a proprietary battery enclosure.
